_note: Machine-readable self-check checklist (SKILL.md 自查清单 + CP checkpoints). Every item corresponds to a SKILL.md checkpoint or a scripts/check. Levels: gate(hard, must pass before proceeding) / check(run and record) / review(agent judgement, no script).

checkpoints.name: spec_lint
items: entities non-empty (schematic) with unique ids and names
relation from/to target existing entity ids
every relation kind maps onto canonical vocabulary
containment drawn as groups, never as arrows
legend covers every drawn kind, no orphan entries
chart palette size >= unique category count; unit declared
entity/relation carry source(+evidence) where possible

checkpoints.name: export_checks
items: svg.editable_text: real <text>, no text-flattened paths
svg.layers: semantic layer groups present
svg.manifest_embedded + manifest_matches
bitmap.dpi_print >= 300 (print) / 150 (screen)
bitmap.colourspace RGB-family
pdf.header / pdf.pages / pdf.fonts_embedded (best effort)
legend.missing_kinds / legend.orphan_items two-way
traceability entities/relations pixels with source+evidence

checkpoints.name: contract
items: result.json contains every REQUIRED top-level key
case_id present and matches the case
output_contract keys echoed at top level (four forms, no null)
artifacts listed exist on disk
status in {success, partial, failed} and coherent with checks
sources / uncertainty / change_records well-typed and honest

checkpoints.name: post_edit_recheck
items: edit change_records complete (before -> after, reason)
unchanged elements byte-identical in SVG source
all checks re-run after the edit and recorded
no stale label/direction left from the pre-edit figure

checkpoints.name: determinism
items: same manifest + options -> byte-identical SVG (two runs)
result.json identical except generated_at/tool_versions
differences (if any) recorded honestly in TEST.md

self_check_list: 实体名逐字出自材料，无材料外基因/浓度/时间点/单位
关系方向与材料一致(激活≠抑制、上下游不颠倒、包含用分组)
图例项 == 图面实际箭头类型(无缺项无孤儿项)
数值/坐标/单位与数据表逐项一致，改数据可重绘
figure.svg 文字可选中(<text>)、图层可拆(layer-*)、带 id 与 data-* 溯源、内嵌 ER 清单
导出件: PDF 可打开；PNG 有效 DPI 达标；色彩 RGB/sRGB
result.json 含全部契约字段 + case_id，status/sources/uncertainty/change_records 诚实
validate_result.py 输出 VALID；失败分支都在 result.json 有记录
